Title: Add one HTC smartphone to empty cart
Preconditions: Fresh browser context, guest (logged out), empty cart, currency USD.
Steps:
1. Open the HTC smartphone product detail page
2. Note the displayed unit price
3. Set Qty to 1
4. Click Add to cart
5. Open Shopping cart
Expected Result:
Cart has exactly 1 row
Name = HTC smartphone
Unit price = price noted in step 2 ($245.00)
Qty = 1
Line total = $245.00
Subtotal = $245.00
